subject: Governance & performance check-in: latency targets, deployment preference, procurement path
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@novamed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 22:12:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up: governance & performance notes + next steps

Claire — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions so we can move toward procurement: 

- Performance targets you mentioned: p95 generation latency target ~350ms for your standard inference workload (multi-turn chat, avg prompt length ~120 tokens). You also called out a burst requirement during business hours (~500 rps for short windows).
- Preferred deployment: you said "private VPC" is the likely path for PHI-sensitive flows, with Dedicated as a fallback for initial pilot.
- Security/Compliance: Novamed will need SOC 2 Type II evidence, encryption at rest KMS integration, and an access audit log export.

Can you confirm the p95 target and expected steady-state RPS? Also, who from procurement should we loop in (name + email) so we can share the procurement checklist and an initial SOW/SLA?

Attachments: I dropped an initial procurement map and a short SLA draft we can iterate on (stubs below).

Next steps we suggest:
1) You confirm p95/RPS and procurement contact.
2) We share a quick SOC 2 evidence index and a draft SOW.
3) Intro call with procurement + security to scope audit artifact delivery (30 minutes).

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call tomorrow if useful.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-SLA-draft.pdf (stub), procurement-MAP.xlsx (stub)

From: Claire Huang <claire@novamed.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: governance & performance notes + next steps

Sergio —

Appreciate the recap. Confirming the p95 goal: we aim for <= 350ms for standard prompts (our UX team measures perceived latency at p95). Steady-state for the pilot is ~120 rps; full production could be 700-900 rps within 3–6 months. Bursts up to ~500 rps for specific campaigns are expected in month 1 (we will throttle client-side if needed).

Procurement contact is: "Novamed Procurement" <procurement@novamed.com>. Please include our InfoSec lead, Kevin Ma (kevin.ma@novamed.com), on the security artifacts thread.

One ask from legal: we prefer a 30-day payment term for pilots if possible and a clause about data residency for PHI (US only).

Would be great to get the SOC 2 evidence index and any sample audit logs you can share. Can Monica lead the security artifact handoff?

Thanks,
Claire
Director, Product — Novamed Health

Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: governance & performance notes + next steps

Claire — looping in the security responses and initial artifact plan. Thanks for confirming the numeric targets; that helps shape the SLOs. Quick notes from InfoSec/Trust: 

- SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report and a mapped evidence index (will attach index CSV).
- Audit logs: we can export per-customer access logs and token-level event history; retention windows are configurable (default 90 days, longer retention available as add-on).
- Key management: support for customer-managed KMS in private deployments (bring-your-own KMS) — we list steps in the attachment.

Performance & deployment tradeoffs:
- Private VPC (recommended for PHI): full isolation, supports BYOK KMS, slightly longer onboarding (~2–4 weeks).
- Dedicated (hosted dedicated capacity): faster ramp (~1 week), predictable throughput, suitable if you can accept Redwood-managed keying.

SLA notes (attached draft):
- P95 latency target: we recommend an operational SLO of 350ms for the pilot with objectives for improvement across rollout.
- Availability SLA: 99.9% for Dedicated; for Private VPC we can negotiate based on deployment topology.
- Fallbacks: automatic routing to a compatible model variant in another region in case of capacity constraints (we'll include a fallback plan in SOW).

Attachments: security-evidence-index.csv (stub), redwood-SLA-draft.pdf (stub). I also added a short procurement-MAP.xlsx with suggested kickoff milestones for SOW, legal review, and PO issuance.

Proposed next step: intro call (procurement + Kevin) on Thursday 12/10 at 16:00 UTC — does that work for you both?

— Monica Patel
Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

Claire / Kevin / procurement team — thanks for the quick replies and confirming targets. Finalizing next steps here so procurement has what you need: 

Action items:
- Sergio/Ben: we will send an updated SOW + pilot pricing and a version of the SLA showing the 350ms p95 objective and availability metrics. (Deliverable: SOW + pricing PDF) — target 12/11 EOD.
- Monica: will share the security index + sample audit log format and BYOK onboarding checklist. (Deliverable: security-evidence-index.csv) — target 12/11 EOD.
- Novamed Procurement: please confirm PO cadence and billing contact + whether a 30-day pilot term is acceptable to legal (Claire mentioned this).
- Scheduling: Monica proposed an intro call 12/10 16:00 UTC — if that still works, Monica, please send calendar invite and dial-in.

Notes on pilot sizing (to make procurement easier):
- Pilot configuration we recommend: Dedicated pool with 2x baseline workers to cover steady-state (120 rps) + headroom for bursts; autoscaling to cover up to 700 rps for production ramp.
- Cost levers: quantization + prefix caching can reduce per-token cost by ~25–40% for your workloads; we'll include recommended profiles in the SOW.

We attached the DocuSign pre-authorized signature link for the master SOW when you're ready (link below).

If procurement wants a modified payment term for pilot (30 days), we can flag to finance and move quickly — please advise.

Thanks — will follow up with the documents listed above.

— Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference\sergio@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-SLA-draft.pdf (updated stub), procurement-MAP.xlsx (stub), https://www.docusign.net/embedded/sign/ABCD1234
